name: inclusive_discount_and_comp
description: LAUNCH-P4 C1: discounts and comps come off the GROSS (VAT-inclusive) prices, then the VAT is taken out of what is left. Lines 1.500 x2 + 1.000 x1 = raw 4.000. Grand = G = 2.600; identity raw - discount - comp = grand: 4000 - 400 - 1000 = 2600.
